title: Sooji Roat
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -In a frying pan,add semolina & dry roast on low flame until fragrant (4-5 minutes) & take out in a separate bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: -Frying pan mein sooji dal dein aur halki ancch per khushbu ajanay tak dry roast ker lein (4-5 minutes) & bowl mein nikal lein.

steps.instruction: -In the same frying pan,add wheat flour & dry roast on low flame for 2-3 minutes & takeout in the same bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: -Us he frying pan mein atta dal dein aur halki ancch per 2-3 minutes kliya dry roast ker lein & bowl mein nikal lein.

steps.instruction: -In the same frying pan,add clarified butter & let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: -Us he frying pan mein ghee dal ker melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add almonds,pistachios,raisins,dry dates & dry roast on low flame for 3-4 minutes & takeout in the same bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: -Badam,pista,kishmish aur chuwaray dal dein aur halki ancch per 3-4 minutes kliya dry roast ker lein & bowl mein nikal lein.

steps.instruction: -Add sugar,poppy seeds,desiccated coconut,cardamom powder,baking soda,pink salt,clarified butter, kewra essence & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cheeni,khashkhash,elaichi powder,baking soda,pink salt,ghee aur kewra essence dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Gradually add water while it still warm & mix well until dough is formed,cover & let it rest for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker ke dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 30 minutes kliya chor dein.

steps.instruction: -With the help of greased hand,take 100g of mixture & make a ball.
steps.romanUrdu: -Greased haath ki madad sa 100g mixture la ker ball bana lein.

steps.instruction: -Place it on a smooth surface,press gently,add almonds,pistachios & poppy seeds,cover with butter paper & press gently to spread it.
steps.romanUrdu: -Smooth surface per rakh ker gently press ker lein,badam,pista aur khashkhash dal dein aur butter paper sa cover ker ka gently press ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Place roat on a baking tray lined with butter paper & bake in preheated oven at 180C for 30-35 minutes (on both grills).
steps.romanUrdu: -Roat ko baking tray lined with butter paper per rakh dein aur preheated oven mein 180C per 30-35 minutes kliya bake ker lein (on both grills).

steps.instruction: -On non-stick griddle,place roat & cook on very low flame from both sides until golden & crispy (30-35 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: -Non-stick tawa per roat rakh dein aur bohat halki ancch per dono sides sa golden & crispy ho janya tak paka lein (30-35 minutes).
-Bech bech mein sides ko turn aur rotate kertay rahein.
